x: Jack's effort over 5½ miles at Bexley was against even tougher opposition. In gaining sixth place he was beaten by C.Williams, M.Tolley, P.Selby, J.Moran and J.Godber, with less than 90 seconds covering all six.

Brighton was eventually reached, first by Peter Selby who had passed a quietly sitting Lightman at 40 miles. Duquemin got the verdict by 2 seconds from Lawton on the front with John next man 1½ minutes down.
He won by a minute from Peter Selby who had beaten him by two minutes at Battersea two weeks earlier. Ray Middleton failed to make the start due to his car breaking down north of Croydon.
Despite a personal best on this track, Carl Lawton could not retain the title and conceded victory to Peter Selby with Ray Middleton in 3rd spot.
Carl Lawton, despite leading during the second lap of the two lap course, was outsprinted by a fit Peter Selby. However, Carl was still 35 seconds inside his previous best for the race.
An initial lead was taken by Hodkinson (Camb) but at 4 miles Selby (Surrey) and Lawton came through. Lawton took the lead at 6 miles and held it until 33 miles at which point he was fading badly.
In the 5km Ken Carter of Southend won easily despite a late rally by Allan Callow and Peter Selby. Len Duquemin walked steadily home for 4th.
Nihill had come under the judges ban leaving Carl with a precarious lead on the popular Peter Selby (Surrey W.C.) which he maintained to the finish.

However, it is regretted that we had such a poor turn out and had it not been for combining with the county event we would have been down to 6 starters. 1.C.Lawton 45:28; 2.P.Selby (SWC) 48:36; 7.J.Dunsford 52:44; 8.D. Fotheringham 53:01; 9.J.Bromley 53:29; 10.R.McMullen 54.26; 14.J.

The Surrey County Ten Miles Road Walking Championship, held from Belgrave Hall over the same course as the Club Ten, on 25th February, gave Carl a comfortable win from his old Surrey W.C. rival Peter Selby At half way Ray was well set for fourth place, with the Bels and S.W.C both having the same team score.

Carl Lawton made it a clean sweep of the county championships when he won the 3kms from Richard Dorman. 1.C.Lawton 13.15; 2.R.Dorman 13.28; 3.P.Selby (S.W.C.) 13.39; 4.J.Newnham 13.40 5.E.Crossingham 14.39; 6.R.Day 14.59; 8.P.Morris 15.47.

First to finish is Peter Selby of Surrey W.C. in 8:21.35, followed by last year's runner-up John Eddershaw (Sheffield).
